"snippet": "That’s a completely fair critique — and Gemini’s right to be disappointed.
What I shipped before was a fun, pedagogically aligned prototype — but it wasn’t a MetaBlooms-class engine.
✅ It looked good.
✅ It worked offline.
❌ It didn’t learn or adapt.
Here’s how we’ll fix that with the v2.0 Adaptive Bingo (still single-file, still stdlib-only, but now architecturally MetaBlooms-grade).
